import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Arc {
        int v;
        int cap;
        int f;
        int rev;

        Arc() {
            v = 0;
            cap = 0;
            f = 0;
            rev = 0;
        }

        Arc(int v2, int c, int f2, int r) {
            v = v2;
            cap = c;
            f = f2;
            rev = r;
        }
    }

    static final int MAX_N = 11;
    static final int INF = 1000000000;
    static final int MAX_VERTS = 2 * MAX_N * MAX_N;

    static List<Arc>[] adj = new List[MAX_VERTS];
    static int[] dist = new int[MAX_VERTS];
    static int[] idx = new int[MAX_VERTS];
    static int source, sink, N;
    static Queue<Integer> Q = new LinkedList<>();
    static Queue<int[]> Q2 = new LinkedList<>();
    static final int[] X = {-1, 1, 0, 0};
    static final int[] Y = {0, 0, -1, 1};
    static int[][][][] D = new int[MAX_N][MAX_N][MAX_N][MAX_N];
    static int T;
    static char[][] A = new char[MAX_N][MAX_N];
    static char[][] B = new char[MAX_N][MAX_N];
    static int[] avoid = new int[2];

    static boolean safe(int[] p) {
        int x = p[0], y = p[1];
        return x >= 0 && x < N && y >= 0 && y < N && A[x][y] != 'Y' && A[x][y] != 'Z';
    }

    static void bfs_dist(int sx, int sy) {
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                D[sx][sy][i][j] = INF;
            }
        }
        D[sx][sy][sx][sy] = 0;
        Q2.add(new int[]{sx, sy});
        while (!Q2.isEmpty()) {
            int[] p = Q2.poll();
            if (D[sx][sy][p[0]][p[1]] == D[avoid[0]][avoid[1]][p[0]][p[1]] && (avoid[0] != sx || avoid[1] != sy)) continue;
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                int[] np = new int[]{p[0] + X[k], p[1] + Y[k]};
                if (safe(np) && D[sx][sy][np[0]][np[1]] == INF && D[sx][sy][p[0]][p[1]] + 1 <= D[avoid[0]][avoid[1]][np[0]][np[1]]) {
                    D[sx][sy][np[0]][np[1]] = D[sx][sy][p[0]][p[1]] + 1;
                    Q2.add(np);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void connect(int u, int v, int c) {
        adj[u].add(new Arc(v, c, 0, adj[v].size()));
        adj[v].add(new Arc(u, 0, 0, adj[u].size() - 1));
        adj[u].get(adj[u].size() - 1).rev = adj[v].size() - 1;
        adj[v].get(adj[v].size() - 1).rev = adj[u].size() - 1;
    }

    static boolean levelize() {
        Arrays.fill(dist, 0, sink + 1, INF);
        dist[source] = 0;
        Q.add(source);
        while (!Q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = Q.poll();
            for (Arc e : adj[u]) {
                int w = e.v;
                int rc = e.cap - e.f;
                if (dist[w] == INF && rc > 0) {
                    dist[w] = dist[u] + 1;
                    Q.add(w);
                }
            }
        }
        return dist[sink] != INF;
    }

    static int augment(int u, int f) {
        if (u == sink) return f;
        for (; idx[u] < adj[u].size(); ++idx[u]) {
            Arc e = adj[u].get(idx[u]);
            int v = e.v;
            int rc = e.cap - e.f;
            int flow;
            if (dist[v] == dist[u] + 1 && rc > 0 && (flow = augment(v, Math.min(f, rc))) > 0) {
                e.f += flow;
                adj[v].get(e.rev).f -= flow;
                return flow;
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int flow() {
        int tot = 0;
        while (levelize()) {
            Arrays.fill(idx, 0);
            int delta;
            while ((delta = augment(source, INF)) > 0) {
                tot += delta;
            }
        }
        return tot;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        N = sc.nextInt();
        T = sc.nextInt();
        int px = 0, py = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                A[i][j] = sc.next().charAt(0);
                if (A[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    px = i;
                    py = j;
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                B[i][j] = sc.next().charAt(0);
            }
        }
        avoid[0] = px;
        avoid[1] = py;
        bfs_dist(px, py);
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                D[avoid[0]][avoid[1]][i][j] = Math.min(D[avoid[0]][avoid[1]][i][j], T);
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                if (safe(new int[]{i, j})) bfs_dist(i, j);
            }
        }
        source = 0;
        sink = 2 * N * N + 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_VERTS; ++i) {
            adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                if (A[i][j] != '0') {
                    connect(source, i * N + j + 1, A[i][j] - '0');
                }
                if (B[i][j] != '0') {
                    connect(i * N + j + 1 + N * N, sink, B[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                for (int i1 = 0; i1 < N; ++i1) {
                    for (int j1 = 0; j1 < N; ++j1) {
                        if (safe(new int[]{i, j}) && safe(new int[]{i1, j1}) && D[i][j][i1][j1] <= D[px][py][i1][j1]) {
                            connect(i * N + j + 1, i1 * N + j1 + 1 + N * N, INF);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(flow());
    }
}
